article.body:
An original Chabad tune
Words were added to this niggun for the Rebbe’s 68th birthday in תש״ל‎ (1970), the 20th year of the Nesius. It was the first time the Rebbe’s kapital was celebrated with a song.
The Rebbe requested that the chayolim sing this niggun at the Tzivos Hashem rally held on Zos Chanukah תשמ״ג‎ (1982), as well as at numerous other rallies.

A Birthday Niggun

Freidel Shir will soon be eight years old.

"You've been studying your new kapitel for days," says her older sister Sara. "Are you memorizing it?"

"Actually, I want to make my own birthday niggun!"

"Like the Rebbe’s?"

"Mommy says she remembers hearing it often at the children's rallies,” Sara says, nodding. “It talks about how all the Yidden will go to Eretz Yisroel, build it up, and live there—with Melech Hamoshiach, of course!"

"You’re making me excited! I’m going to compose a very happy, thankful birthday niggun from the second and third pessukim of Kapital Tes."
